description: SHELL GOLDEN — hollow a body to a uniform wall thickness, opening a picked face (the housing / enclosure / cup primitive). The 40x25x10 box shelled to a 2 mm wall with the TOP face (+Z, z=10) left open -> an open-top box: outer 40x25x10, inner cavity 36x21x8 (2 mm wall on all four sides and the floor; the open top has NO wall, so the cavity reaches z=10). A three-feature TREE (sketch -> extrude -> shell{faces: picked top}) through the evaluate-tree path: planegcs solve -> profile face -> 10 mm prism -> resolve the top-face SubshapeRef against body.faces() (exactly one) -> OCCT MakeThickSolid inward offset (thickness -2) removing the top face -> GProp -> tessellation -> content-addressed GLB. Byte-determinism incl. interpreter restart proves the FACE ref resolves the same across a fresh rebuild (the sketch-on-face signature machinery reused for openings); the parametrized STEP round-trip re-imports the hollow (all-planar) B-rep.
derivation: Expectations are HAND-DERIVED analytic values, cross-checked against the harness (geometry-gates skill: a golden recorded from buggy output enshrines the bug). Base body is the 40x25x10 box (volume 10000 mm^3). Shell thickness t=2 mm, uniform INWARD offset, TOP face removed (open).

cavity dims: the inward offset moves each RETAINED wall face inward by t=2. x: 0..40 -> inner 2..38 = 36 wide. y: 0..25 -> inner 2..23 = 21 deep. z: the FLOOR (bottom, retained) offsets up to z=2, but the TOP is removed (open), so the cavity is NOT capped and reaches the top at z=10 -> inner z 2..10 = 8 tall. cavity = 36*21*8 = 6048 mm^3.

volume = outer - cavity = 10000 - 6048 = 3952 mm^3. (Harness reproduces 3952.0 EXACTLY — planar geometry, MakeThickSolid on a box yields exact planar faces; deviation 0.0.) OCCT-SHELL SUBTLETY (reconciled, docs/GEOMETRY-QA.md 2026-07-13): the inward offset removes t from each retained wall but NOT from the removed top, so cavity height is 10 - t = 8 (one wall in z, not two); analytic and OCCT agree to 0.0.

surface_area: outer skin minus the removed top = bottom 40*25=1000 + four outer walls 2*(40*10)+2*(25*10)=1300 => 2300. Inner cavity = inner floor 36*21=756 + four inner walls (height 8) 2*(36*8)+2*(21*8)=912 => 1668. Top rim frame (the 2 mm-wide annulus around the opening) = outer 40*25=1000 minus opening 36*21=756 => 244. surface_area = 2300 + 1668 + 244 = 4212 mm^2 (harness 4212.0 exactly, deviation 0.0).

centroid: two mirror symmetries survive (planes x=20 and y=12.5), so centroid.x=20 and centroid.y=12.5 EXACTLY. z: outer box centroid z=5 (V=10000); cavity centroid z = (2+10)/2 = 6 (V=6048). centroid.z = (10000*5 - 6048*6)/3952 = (50000 - 36288)/3952 = 13712/3952 = 3.4696356275303644 mm (float64; the harness reproduces 3.4696356275303653, deviation 8.9e-16 mm absorbed by the tolerance).
bounding_box = [0,0,0]..[40,25,10]: an INWARD shell leaves the outer envelope untouched (the wall grows into the solid), and the open top does not change the extent.

topology: 11 faces = 5 outer (bottom + 4 side walls; the top is REMOVED) + 5 inner (inner floor + 4 inner walls; the inner top is open, no cap) + 1 top rim frame (a rectangle-with-rectangular-hole around the opening). 24 edges = outer bottom 4 + outer verticals 4 + top-outer rim rectangle 4 + top-inner opening rectangle 4 + inner verticals 4 + inner floor 4. 1 shell. Vertices: outer 8 + inner-top 4 + inner-floor 4 = 16 (Euler with one face carrying a hole: V - E + F = 16 - 24 + 11 = 3 = 2 + (loops-in-excess), the rim's inner loop contributing the +1).

mesh (linear 0.1 mm / angular 0.1 rad, isRelative=False): every face is PLANAR, so deflection does not subdivide any face. 10 rectangular faces (4 outer walls + outer bottom + inner floor + 4 inner walls) = 4 nodes / 2 triangles each = 40 nodes / 20 triangles. The 1 rim frame (rectangle with a rectangular hole, 8 boundary nodes, no interior node) triangulates to 8 nodes / 8 triangles. Totals = 48 vertices and 28 triangles (per-face faceted normals, no vertex sharing across faces -- the same convention as the box/plate goldens).

GLB byte size is deliberately NOT pinned here: asserted deterministic (byte-identical) by the runner within one kernel version, but pinning the absolute size would break on glTF-writer upgrades without geometric meaning.
tolerance_rationale: PLANAR-geometry tolerance, measured then set (geometry-gates skill: never copy a bound blindly). Every face of the shelled body is planar, so the GProp integrals are exact-in-principle; the only residual is float round-off in the MakeThickSolid offset + centroid quotient. Measured deviations vs the analytic values (2026-07-13, build123d 0.11.1 / OCCT 7.9, planegcs 0.8.0): volume 0.0, surface_area 0.0, centroid.x 0.0, centroid.y 0.0, centroid.z 8.9e-16 mm, AABB exact. Documented ceiling 1e-9 = ~1e6x the observed worst case (centroid.z), matching the planar chamfer-plate-d5 / sketch-extrude posture with headroom for libm/platform variation across CI hosts. The solver contributes zero error by construction (zero-residual start, solved == input bitwise). Loosening this bound requires a reviewed kernel-level justification recorded here and in docs/GEOMETRY-QA.md.
